svg.aria-label: Animated schematic: developmental stages accumulate to an E9.5 embryo, germ-layer identities are acquired, brain, telencephalon, eye, heart, tail and somites are labelled on the embryo, the view zooms into the telencephalon, cortical subtypes emerge, the same subtypes appear in an adult coronal section, and one post-mitotic L5 neuron holds its identity for decades while reprogramming attempts rebound.
